title: OutboxEntry
description: A message waiting to be delivered to a tracker or chat, exactly once.

id.description: `sha256(run_id, op, target)` in hex; also the idempotency marker `[errand:<id>]`.

target.description: Where it goes (a ticket key, a channel id).

body.description: The text to post, before the marker is appended.

delivered_at.description: Delivery time, set only after the tracker confirmed it.

attempts.description: How many delivery attempts were made.

last_error.description: The last delivery error, if any.
